data.name: Dhana
data.gender_notes: Dhana is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dhana is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘dhan’, which means wealth, fortune, or prosperity. In Hindu mythology, Dhana is considered the goddess of wealth and is often depicted holding a pot of gold coins or sitting on a lotus. She is believed to bless her devotees with financial success and abundance. The name Dhana carries the meaning “Wealth, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dhana usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Dhana belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealth, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dhana total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

The name is also given to children born on auspicious occasions or on days considered lucky for wealth acquisition. The name is a reminder of the importance of hard work, integrity, and careful financial management in Hindu society.
